scope: Synthesize current FreeCAD, SAT/SAB parser, kernel, renderer, and licensed-consumer routes into a minimum-cost composed evidence sequence without changing the implementation queue.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project documentation, exact release documentation, and current plan entries.
method.limitations: Documentation and repository statements identify route boundaries but are not runtime or geometry qualification. No licensed reader, FreeCAD backend, native platform, payload, or drawing was exercised.

observed: The documented DWG workflow uses an external converter and then the selected DXF importer.
FreeCAD maintainer response to issue 18454 says stock FreeCAD cannot read ACIS blobs.
Importer backend and import settings affect which DXF entity families can be consumed.
doesNotEstablish: ACIS/SAB semantics or DWG AcDs association
behavior of every FreeCAD build, converter, importer backend, or platform

observed: Separate bare SAT/SAB parser route with profile and loss reporting.
Project support ladder documents L1/profile-level support for this codec.
No DWG/DXF/AcDs container route or geometry kernel is documented.
doesNotEstablish: a successful run on the target payload

observed: Separate SAT/SAB/ASM parser with explicitly bounded save-profile and geometry conversion scopes.
Supported geometry can be converted through CadQuery/OpenCASCADE.
OCCT kernel lineage is shared with FreeCAD.
doesNotEstablish: an independent kernel vote or a completed local run

observed: Optional DXF wrapper extracts SAT/SAB and calls its ACIS reader before constructing FreeCAD Part objects.
Project documents unsupported geometry and no SAT/SAB/DXF export.
doesNotEstablish: complete closed solids for all profiles or an independent kernel

routeFindings.route: HOOPS Exchange and Ansys ACIS import
observed: Commercial documentation describes SAT/SAB geometry reader routes; HOOPS also documents DWG/DXF import, while Ansys documents selected DWG/DXF and SAT/SAB profiles.
doesNotEstablish: runtime availability or license on this task host
exact target-file support or expected geometry

observed: OpenCADStudio uses the ACadRust codec family; ProGPU describes renderer-local edge projection; ProCad reader lineage is ACadSharp-family.
doesNotEstablish: independent parser votes across correlated applications
full B-rep semantic validity from tessellation, pixels, or edge output

planRefinements: Split stock-FreeCAD explicit-entity qualification from ACIS/AcDs semantics; native Linux and Windows runs bind exact converter, importer backend, settings, output, and platform.
Use the observed inner payload signature/save version for admission; the outer ACADVER does not substitute for the inner SAT/SAB/ASM profile.
At the existing composed checkpoint, verify source entity to AcDs owner/key/record/payload identity and exact payload digest before feeding the payload to any parser.
Use one bare-payload parser for typed/raw/loss census, followed by one geometry route and independent analytic expectations; label shared OCCT lineage explicitly.
Keep all peer/native checks out of per-slice validation and leave unavailable routes NOT_AVAILABLE/NOT_RUN while local implementation continues.
